caption: The drawing depicts a composite of architectural and decorative elements divided into distinct sections. On the left, there are panels filled with repeated floral patterns: the uppermost section is pink with green six-petal floral designs, bordered at the top by a curving orange and yellow edge, and separated by a blue braided tassel garland with blue fringe; the panel below this is a grid of squares, each containing a green floral motif on a pink background intersected by thin gold lines. Underneath, to the left, is a section with a yellow floral design on a pink background, and to the right of this, a vertically-oriented green panel with light green leaves and floral patterns. The blue garland with fringe is draped along the boundary of the pink and green sections. To the right of the drawing, an architectural structure is shown: at the top, red and white columns and balusters atop a cornice with a rectangular blue-and-white detail beneath; below, a frieze with blue circular motifs on a white background runs horizontally; the space below is ochre-colored with star-like decorations in gray. This meets a projecting white cornice with gray and pink shading, under which a blue band with black floral motifs runs horizontally. The entire composition uses pencil and watercolor, with accurate lines and pastel tones.
title: Detail of Wall Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
